summary: Reorders Boolean-check before the falsy-self shortcut in Float.__eq__, so Float 0.0 vs BooleanFalse now consistently returns False regardless of comparison order, fixing the asymmetry root cause with a minimal, correct change.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why Boolean check must precede the `not self` shortcut; future edits could silently reorder and reintroduce the asymmetry.
